versions.changelog:
Initial release of the install-calibrate skill.

- Provides guided installation, configuration, and verification of the Calibrate browser SDK and sidecar for JavaScript/TypeScript projects.
- Supports both fast and manual workflows for onboarding and troubleshooting in React/Vite and generic ESM browser apps.
- Enforces guardrails for privacy, secret handling, and custom integrations.
- Details failure modes, recovery steps, and explicit completion criteria.
- Uses the calibrate CLI and related commands for all tasks; no infrastructure deployment included.
